name: Spell Blade
description: Infuse a weapon strike with arcane energy, dealing both physical and magic damage.
flavor_text: Two arts, one edge.

name: Arcane Strike
description: Each melee attack has a chance to release a burst of arcane energy.
flavor_text: The spell is always loaded.

name: Holy Blade
description: Imbue your weapon with divine light, dealing bonus holy damage especially effective against undead.
flavor_text: The light judges all.

name: Lay on Hands
description: Channel divine healing through touch, restoring a significant amount of HP.
flavor_text: Faith made manifest.

name: Wild Surge
description: Release an unpredictable burst of chaotic energy that deals random elemental damage.
flavor_text: Even you don't know what happens next.

name: Chaotic Aura
description: Your very presence warps probability, giving all your actions a luck-based bonus.
flavor_text: Chaos favours those who embrace it.

name: Mana Blade
description: Condense raw mana into a shimmering edge along your weapon and cut with it.
flavor_text: Steel is optional. Intent is not.

name: Runic Armor
description: Protective runes etched into your gear flare on impact, turning your armor into a spell-hardened shell.
flavor_text: Every rune is a promise the blow will not land clean.

name: Spellsword Surge
description: Unleash a flurry of blade strikes, each one discharging stored arcane power into the target.
flavor_text: The sword remembers every spell you ever fed it.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: Your weapon is permanently wreathed in flame; every basic attack sears the target for extra fire damage.
flavor_text: It has not been cold since the day you lit it.

name: Null Field
description: A thin skin of anti-magic clings to you at all times, granting strong magic resist against hostile spells.
flavor_text: Spells arrive. Most of them do not survive the trip.

name: Blade Resonance
description: Each basic attack sets your blade humming; the echo of the strike lands a heartbeat later.
flavor_text: The second cut is the one they never see.

name: Anti-Magic Edge
description: A precise cut that severs the flow of mana around the target, dealing heavy damage.
flavor_text: Whatever was holding it together, you cut that too.

name: Dimension Cut
description: A single strike that slices through space itself. Devastating damage at a steep mana cost.
flavor_text: For an instant, there are two of the world. Then there is one.

name: Dark Nova
description: Collapse the shadows around your target into a single point, then let them burst.
flavor_text: Light leaves. Something else arrives.

name: Soul Drain
description: Reach into the target and pull at the thread of its life, dealing shadow damage.
flavor_text: It does not hurt. That is the worst part.

name: Void Walk
description: Part of you always stands a half-step inside the dark, letting you evade attacks that should have landed.
flavor_text: They hit the shadow. You were never in it.

name: Nightmare Bind
description: Trap the target inside its own worst fear. The terror tears at its body as surely as any blade.
flavor_text: Everyone is afraid of something. You simply ask what.

name: Divine Strike
description: A weapon blow carried by holy conviction, dealing physical and radiant damage.
flavor_text: Your arm swings. Something greater follows through.

name: Consecration
description: Sanctify the ground under your enemy; holy fire rises to burn what does not belong.
flavor_text: This ground is spoken for.

name: Aura of Protection
description: Your vows manifest as a steady aura that hardens around you like a second suit of armor.
flavor_text: You stand. Therefore they are safe.

name: Judgment
description: Pronounce sentence on a single foe. A pillar of light answers, scaled by your Strength and Wisdom.
flavor_text: The verdict was never in question.

name: Reality Glitch
description: Something about the target briefly fails to render. When it resolves, it resolves wrong.
flavor_text: ERROR: ENTITY STATE INCONSISTENT.

name: Fortune Strike
description: Stake everything on a single blow and let probability decide how hard it lands.
flavor_text: Heads, you win. Tails, they lose.

name: Adapt
description: Your body rewrites itself between fights, quietly growing stronger in whatever way the last one demanded.
flavor_text: The System keeps trying to pin you down. You keep changing shape.

name: Undefined Power
description: Draw on a power the System has no name for and release it all at once.
flavor_text: NULL. NULL. NULL. NULL.
